dedupe_keys.name: toop transmission grid topology optimisation engine

description: ToOp is Elia Group's Python engine for finding transmission-grid topology changes that reduce congestion. It imports operational networks, preprocesses constraints, searches with a GPU-based DC power-flow solver and filters candidate solutions with AC power flow. Available actions include line switching, busbar splitting or reassignment and grouped phase-shifting-transformer taps. Inputs include network snapshots, masks and contingency definitions; outputs are Pareto-optimal candidate actions and their evaluated performance. Spatial coverage follows the supplied network, with each workload representing selected operating states. Source is free under MPL-2.0, using HDF5 and JSON intermediate definitions. A limitation is that accelerated batches may differ only in supported topology and outage dimensions. The repository supplies the engine, not a complete operator interface. ToOp supports congestion and intervention simulations, related to network analysis with OpenDSS (platform-opendss). Its README cites separate solver and optimiser papers. No operational grid data was accessed.
